## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the *Maitreya-paripṛcchā* — the bodhisattva Maitreya's inquiry concerning the *běn yuàn* 本願 (the original vow / *pūrva-praṇidhāna*) of the bodhisattva path. The text is one of the foundational Maitreya-cycle Mahāyāna sūtras.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE).

The Taishō text (T0349) is established on the standard apparatus.
